---
title: "1-generate-rules"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(arules)
  library(arulesViz)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

# Helper to resolve a file that may be in CWD or under dara/
resolve_path <- function(fname) {
  if (file.exists(fname)) return(fname)
  p <- file.path("dara", fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  stop(sprintf("File not found: %s", fname))
}

# Load categorized dataset

#malaria <- load_rdata(resolve_path("dataset.RData"))
files <- c(
  "malaria_2016.RData",
  "malaria_2017.RData",
  "malaria_2018.RData",
  "malaria_2019.RData"
)

datasets <- lapply(files, function(file){

  objs <- load(
    file.path("~/pratica-pesquisa/datasets", file)
  )

  get(objs[1])

})

malaria <- bind_rows(datasets)

save(
  malaria,
  file = "dataset.RData"
)
names(malaria)

# Select attributes of interest
data <- subset(malaria, select = c(names(malaria)) )

# Transform to factors
pf_data <- data.frame(lapply(data, as.factor))

# Generate association rules targeting tmn.geral=alto
rules <- apriori(
  pf_data,
  parameter = list(supp = 0.1, conf = 0.8, minlen = 3, maxlen = 4, target = "rules"),
  appearance = list(rhs = "exam.result=vivax"),
  control = list(verbose = FALSE)
)

message(sprintf("Number of rules: %d", length(rules)))

# Compute interest measures and filter
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules, transactions = data)
rules <- rules[imrules$lift >= 1 & imrules$count > 1]
message(sprintf("Number of rules (filtering lift & count): %d", length(rules)))
rules <- rules[!is.redundant(rules)]
message(sprintf("Number of rules (after redundancy filter): %d", length(rules)))

# Convert to data.frame with interest measures
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules, transactions = data)
dataset <- as(rules, "data.frame")

if (length(rules) > 0) {
  # Split lhs/rhs and normalize RHS label for downstream matching
  splitted <- str_split(dataset$rules, " => ", simplify = TRUE)
  dataset <- data.frame(
    lhs = splitted[, 1],
    rhs = gsub("_", "=", gsub("exam.result=", "", splitted[, 2])),
    support = dataset$support,
    confidence = dataset$confidence,
    lift = imrules$lift,
    count = imrules$count,
    kulc = imrules$kulczynski,
    ir = imrules$imbalance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Clean braces
dataset$rhs <- gsub("\\{", "", dataset$rhs)
dataset$rhs <- gsub("\\}", "", dataset$rhs)
dataset$lhs <- gsub("\\{", "", dataset$lhs)
dataset$lhs <- gsub("\\}", "", dataset$lhs)

# Recreate original attribute columns present in data for easier joins later
for (nm in names(data)) dataset[[nm]] <- NA

# Fill attribute columns according to LHS items
lhs_items <- str_split(dataset$lhs, ",")
for (i in seq_along(lhs_items)) {
  kvs <- lhs_items[[i]]
  for (kv in kvs) {
    nv <- str_split(kv, "=", simplify = TRUE)
    if (ncol(nv) == 2) {
      dataset[i, trimws(nv[1, 1])] <- trimws(nv[1, 2])
    }
  }
}

# Convert interest measures to numeric explicitly
num_cols <- c("lift","count","confidence","support","kulc","ir")
for (nc in num_cols) dataset[[nc]] <- as.numeric(dataset[[nc]])

# Save to dara/dataset.csv
#out_path <- resolve_path("malaria.csv")
#write.csv(dataset, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE)
#message(sprintf("Saved rules dataset to %s", out_path))

out_path <- "malaria-rules-lais.RData"

save(
  dataset,
  file = out_path
)

message(sprintf(
  "Arquivo de regras salvo em: %s (%d linhas)",
  out_path,
  nrow(dataset)
))
```
